name: Katrina Prentice
title: Business strategist, keynote speaker and executive coach
bio_short: Business strategist, keynote speaker and executive coach with more than 15 years' experience across Europe, Africa and the Middle East. Clients include Emirates, Microsoft, Nike, BA, Barclays and Hilton. Specialist in public speaking and leadership.
bio: Katrina is a business strategist, keynote speaker and executive coach with more than 15 years' experience across Europe, Africa and the Middle East. Her training style is dynamic, powerful and engaging, and she has worked with senior executives, vice presidents, ambassadors, government officials and political figures from a wide range of organisations. Her clients include BT, British Airways, Emirates, Virgin Airways, Jumeirah, Hilton Hotels, DHL, Barclays Corporate, Nike, Microsoft, Galliford Try, Royal Mail and the NHS.  Katrina combines strong business acumen with coaching expertise. She is a certified executive coach and business trainer, and her approach focuses on helping participants develop confidence, influence and the ability to communicate persuasively in high-stakes professional settings. She has particular experience working with professionals in politically complex and multicultural environments.  At ISOC, Katrina delivers public speaking, leadership communication and interpersonal skills programmes. She is particularly effective at helping participants find and project their authentic voice, developing the kind of presence and impact that distinguishes effective leaders. Her experience across three continents and multiple sectors gives her a cultural adaptability that is valuable for training diverse groups. She has a particular strength in working with women leaders and professionals navigating cross-cultural communication challenges. Katrina is based in the UK and trains in English.
